ticket_content: I've been trying to get the new 'Project Timeline' view to work in the Northbeam app for weeks now. It's been mentioned in several internal emails and demo videos, and I've seen it in the product roadmap for Q3, but it's still not available in the current version. We're using the Northbeam Pro plan and have multiple teams relying on the timeline feature to manage dependencies across projects. Right now, we're using the Gantt view, which is clunky and doesn't sync well with our external calendar tools. The timeline view, especially with drag-and-drop milestones and automatic dependency tracking, would save us hours every week. I've even reached out to the product support team before and was told it's 'in development' — but no timeline has been released. I'm not asking for a workaround, I'm asking for this feature to be built and rolled out. It's not just a small tweak — it's a complete workflow shift. We're already losing productivity because we can't easily visualize project dependencies. If this feature doesn't get prioritized, we're going to have to look at switching to a different project management tool. This has been a major pain point since the start of Q3, and it's becoming critical for our team’s operational efficiency.

Our Slack integration has stopped syncing data for the past 4 hours. All messages are missing from the workspace, and we can't see any updates in our project boards. We've tried refreshing the connection, but it hasn't resolved the issue.

I need all the data from my Northbeam workspace deleted immediately. I've been working with the company for three years, and I'm now exiting the business. I've already requested a data export for audit purposes, but now I need every piece of user, project, and activity data tied to my account — including all team member activity logs, dashboard configurations, and export history — removed completely. I've tried the standard 'delete my account' option, but it only deletes the account, not the underlying data stored in the system. I need a full data purge, and I need it done within the next 24 hours. This is a compliance requirement under my current data protection agreement with our legal team, and I have to provide a certification of data destruction by the end of the day. I've attached a document outlining the data types and retention periods that must be cleared. I’m not asking for a new feature or a login fix — I need every trace of my account and its usage history removed from your servers permanently.

Our entire team can't access the app — the login page just loads a blank screen and times out every time. This has been going on for 4 hours now, and we've tried switching networks, clearing cache, and restarting devices. The service is completely down for all users, and no one can log in or check their dashboards.
Our workspace was suspended after the payment failed for the March subscription, and we can't access any billing information to dispute the charge.
I would like to request a full export of all data stored in my account since January 1st, including user activity logs and project metadata.

I've been locked out of my Northbeam account for over 24 hours now and I'm completely unable to access any of my data or settings. I tried resetting my password via the app and email, but the system keeps saying 'authentication failed' even after multiple attempts. I don't have access to my 2FA device either, and I can't log in from any browser or mobile app. This is affecting every team member on my project, and we're now stuck in a loop of failed logins. I've also noticed that the login screen is showing a message about 'temporary authentication issues' every time I try to enter. I'm concerned this might be a security breach since I didn't authorize any login attempts from a new device. I need immediate help to regain access to my account and verify if there's any unauthorized access. I've already escalated internally, but no one has responded to my messages in the support queue. Our entire workflow is on hold and we're losing client trust due to this. Please confirm if this is a security incident or just a system error. I'm not asking for a new feature — I just need to get back in and know if my data is safe.
I need all my data from the last 18 months exported, including team activity logs and project timelines, for compliance review.

We've been having this issue with the project timeline syncing for weeks now — it's especially bad during the monthly reviews in the Midlands office. The Gantt charts just won’t update after saving, and the milestones keep shifting by 15 minutes every time. I tried restarting the browser, clearing cache, and even switching to Chrome from Firefox, but nothing helps. The team in Birmingham keeps asking if we can just export the timeline as a CSV so they can check manually, but that’s not working either. It feels like the sync is broken between the app and the server. We’re relying on this for client reporting, and without it, we can’t present accurate timelines to our stakeholders. We’re also noticing that the export button is now grayed out in the report dashboard, even though we’ve been using it for months. This is not a login issue or a billing one — it's clearly a bug with how the data syncs across devices and locations. We're losing trust in the system after so much of this has been going on quietly. I’ve reached out to the help desk multiple times and the last response was just 'this is a known issue' with no ETA. We’re now considering switching to a different tool for our internal planning, which is not a good sign.

I've been trying to log in to my Northbeam account for the past 4 hours now, and it's still not working. I reset my password three times and tried using both my phone and recovery email, but every time I get redirected to a screen that says 'invalid credentials'. I don't know what's wrong, and I can't access my team's dashboards or any of our active projects. I've also noticed that our team members are all getting the same error when they try to log in — it's not just me. I'm worried this is a widespread outage, and if it's happening across the whole team, then we're completely blocked from doing work. Our SLA says we have to resolve critical access issues within 15 minutes, but we're not even getting a notification that support is aware of this. I'm starting to think someone may have compromised our account or there's a system-wide failure. I need immediate help and a clear update on whether this is a security breach or just a service error.
The dashboard is showing incorrect dates for all our projects, and it's taking over 30 seconds to load on every page. This has been happening since Monday, and our team can't meet client deadlines.
The app keeps crashing when I try to load the dashboard, and my team in Manchester can't access it either. We've tried reloading, but it's been down for over 45 minutes.
